LightningComponentBundle.description: CMDT-driven registration: programId from URL or page property (comma- or pipe-separated for multiple programs). Brochure flow via isBrochure. Multiple URL programs show in the picker; each selected program creates a Lead Program on submit.

property.name: programIdOverride
property.label: Program Id
property.description: Matches Program_Id__c on custom metadata. Leave blank to use the programId URL parameter.

property.name: brochureModeOverride
property.label: Brochure mode override
property.description: true or false to force brochure vs standard fields. Leave blank to use isBrochure / c__isBrochure URL parameter.
